item.text: {"ticker":"SAP.DE","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. MCP returned a successful FCFF valuation for SAP SE in EUR. The model estimates value per share at EUR 172.87 versus a market price of EUR 151.78 across 15 projection years. Growth is 12.59% for years 2-5, then fades toward 2.43% terminal growth; the mapped Software (System & Application) 2026 growth anchor shows p50 fundamental growth near 14.15% with confidence 1.0. Margins start at 30.0% next year and converge to 24.26%, below SAP's base-year 29.64% but above the industry comparison of 23.53%. Reinvestment is driven by sales-to-capital of 4.01x in years 1-5 and 2.01x in years 6-10, with terminal reinvestment at 33.75%. Cost of capital begins at 9.58% and fades to 7.20%, using a 2.43% risk-free rate and Damodaran mature-market ERP plus country risk premium data dated 2026-04-01. Terminal value is EUR 351.89B, with present value of terminal value at EUR 98.45B, so the result is sensitive to mature-growth, reinvestment, and discount-rate assumptions. Data caveats: Yahoo Finance coverage can be missing, stale, or insufficient; rates are shown in percent, sales-to-capital as a multiple, segment-aware modeling is false, and service/model version fields are null."}
